tasks.subject: Task 1: Fix the CanvasFlows world lookup
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Arrows render again by finding the transformed world through a stable hook.

Complete — landed in merge 7276996. `[data-dc-world]` marks the world and `CanvasFlows` queries it. See the Outcomes section of the plan.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add the perf bench harness and baseline
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pasteable harness that reproduces every number the later tasks are judged against, plus a recorded baseline.

Complete — `perf/bench.js`, documented in README.md. The baseline table in the plan is filled in. Two corrections came out of it: dragFlowCost withdrew Task 6, and patchCost must be judged on framesRenderedPerPatch, not variantSwitchMs.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Write the zoom variable only on settle
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pinch stops invalidating style for the whole world on every frame.

Complete — measured `invWrites` 1 for a 90-tick gesture, against 90 before. Criterion was 1–3. The frame-time criteria stay unverified: the only machine available runs headless at a locked 60 Hz. See Outcomes.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Swap snapshots for a live iframe budget
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Snapshots removed; a slot is a live iframe at any zoom, bounded by DC.liveBudget.

Complete — measured `liveByZoom` at most 8 live at every zoom, against 10 before, and 0 `img.dc-thumb`. A new regression check, "live iframes stay inside the budget", holds the contract. See Outcomes.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Re-render only the artboards a patch changed
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One patchSection re-renders only the slots it changed.

Complete, but only after the code review. The first build measured `framesRenderedPerPatch` 10, one render per slot, against a criterion of at most 2: the sizes map rebuilt every slot's size object on any variant patch, so React.memo never hit. A per-slot size cache brought it to 1. See Outcomes.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Arrow re-route on drag (withdrawn)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Re-route only the arrows a drag moves.

Withdrawn on measurement — a 40-frame drag makes 2 cfMeasure calls, not 44. The existing debounce already coalesces it. `canvas-page.jsx` carries no change from this task. See Outcomes.

tasks.subject: Task 7: First-load fit race (withdrawn)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The canvas opens fitted every time.

Withdrawn — already fixed by dev's acbba3e (restoredView/fittedView/hasContent), covered by the regression suite. See Outcomes.
